units.assertion: The affected rule chapter is chapter 246-203 WAC, General sanitation.

evidence.quote: Title of Rule and Other Identifying Information: Amending chapter 246-203 WAC to create a new section to allow pet dogs to be present in domestic breweries and microbreweries: Pet dogs in domestic breweries and microbreweries.

Purpose of the Proposal and Its Anticipated Effects, Including Any Changes in Existing Rules: The purpose of this rule making is to comply with RCW  66.24.240(7) and  66.24.244(8), which require the state board of health (board) to adopt rules to allow dogs to be present in domestic breweries and microbreweries that are not subject to food service permits. This proposal will require a new subsection to be added to chapter 246-203 WAC, General sanitation.

units.assertion: The reasons supporting the proposal quote RCW  66.24.240(7) and  66.24.244(8) as requiring the board to adopt rules allowing dogs.

evidence.quote: Reasons Supporting Proposal: RCW  66.24.240(7) and  66.24.244(8) require the board to "adopt rules to allow dogs on the premises of licensed domestic breweries that do not provide food service subject to a food service permit requirement." The 2025 legislature passed EHB 1602 (chapter 141, Laws of 2025) that amended multiple statutes to allow domestic breweries and microbreweries to provide food service via contract kitchens. A contract kitchen may take the form of a mobile food service, such as a food truck, or other independently operated food service provider. The bill was codified as RCW  66.24.240,  66.24.244,  66.24.320,  66.24.410,  66.04.010, and  66.24.400, and became effective July 27, 2025.
